submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole retrospectively detects vocabulary of ordinary, recurring daily life: it fires on the current token when it names a time of day or week (morning, noon, dawn, dusk, Monday, weekday), a recurrence or routine (daily, everyday, times, day, usual, routine, habit), an ordinary standard (normal, average, regular, ordinary, typical, plain, alright), or a casual approximator (almost, around), plus routine domestic nouns (lunch, basement, hallway, valley, ground). It stays near zero on other nouns, verbs, adjectives and function words, including near-identical lookalikes (moon vs noon, hay vs hey, today vs day, common vs normal, nearly vs almost).
